stopping_rules: three consecutive controlled experiments without material Pareto improvement

experiments.hypothesis: A pinned pretrained MiniLM NLI evaluator can recover meaningful evidence-conditioned coverage on independent FEVER annotations where the controlled-language parser abstains.
experiments.risk: NLI entailment is not truth; Wikipedia evidence policy differs from production primary-source policy
experiments.gate: held-out validation accuracy and selective-risk analysis; research-only until final-policy calibration qualifies

experiments.hypothesis: Dedicated final-policy calibration improves correctness estimates over raw softmax.
experiments.selection: validation Brier score using calibration-fit half only; other half estimates conservative correctness by fixed bins
experiments.risk: constant scores or sparse independent groups cannot qualify

experiments.hypothesis: Published int8 ONNX weights reduce CPU latency with noninferior predictions relative to fp32.
experiments.gate: paired p95 reduction >=20%, accuracy loss <=1 point, coverage loss <=2 points
experiments.rollback: isolate if failed; no core replacement

locked_test_policy: Hash entire split manifest before candidate validation. Do not execute locked test until configurations are frozen. No tuning on evaluation outcomes.
data_policy: External data stays outside Apache source repository; retain attribution and source licensing. Exclude AVeriTeC. Original FEVER human labels cross-check gold-evidence mirror; preserve NEI. Group all shared evidence pages before splitting.
scope: Historical evidence-conditioned classification and scoped source-record checks; not unrestricted live-world verification. Full Gemini comparisons pending project/access/spend preflight.
